items.bold: TRUMP REJECTED IRAN RESPONSE — "TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE!" Iran: US demanded "surrender." Demands full Hormuz sovereignty.
items.text: CNBC (36 minutes ago) and Times of Israel (2 hours ago) confirmed: Trump posted on Truth Social Sunday evening: "I have just read the response from Iran's so-called 'Representatives.' I don't like it — TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP." Iranian state television framed Tehran's response as a rejection of the US proposal, which it characterised as a demand for "surrender." Iran's response to the latest US proposal insists on: war reparations by the US, full Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, an end to sanctions, the release of seized Iranian assets, an end to the naval blockade, a guarantee of no further attacks, and an end to the US ban on Iranian oil sales. The gap between the two positions is now at its widest since the war began. "TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE" is Trump's hardest language of the entire 73-day war.

items.text: CNBC (36 minutes ago) confirmed: Brent crude futures for July delivery rose 3.16% to $104.49 per barrel Monday morning. WTI futures advanced 3.08% to $95.42. Over the weekend, Iran continued to broaden its drone attack campaign: the UAE said it intercepted two drones coming from Iran; Qatar condemned a drone attack that struck a cargo ship in its waters; Kuwait said its air defenses had encountered hostile drones that entered its airspace. Iran's weekend attacks have now spread beyond the Strait of Hormuz to Qatar and Kuwait — the entire Gulf region is now under Iranian drone threat. This broadening of the attack scope is the most significant military escalation since the April 8 ceasefire, and it is happening simultaneously with the diplomatic collapse from Trump's rejection.

items.bold: MURKOWSKI AUMF TODAY — Senate returned May 11. Trump rejection = WH has no credible plan. AUMF now near-certain.
items.text: Multiple outlets confirmed: Murkowski planned to introduce the AUMF (Authorization for Use of Military Force) measure when the Senate returned from recess on May 11 — if the White House does not have a credible plan. With Trump's "TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE" rejection on Sunday night, the White House now definitively has no credible plan. Murkowski has full political justification to proceed with the AUMF introduction today. If the AUMF is introduced: the Senate must vote on formally authorizing or ending the war. This removes Trump's executive flexibility entirely — either the Senate authorizes the war (giving it congressional oversight) or forces its end. The Murkowski AUMF vote is the single most important US domestic political development of Monday.

assessment.body:
Monday 8:30 AM IST. Day 73. The most bearish India market morning since April 30.

THE OVERNIGHT COLLAPSE
Trump (Truth Social, Sunday evening): "I have just read the response from Iran's so-called 'Representatives.' I don't like it — TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE!"

Iran (state TV): the US proposal amounts to "surrender." Tehran's demands:
• War reparations from the US
• Full Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz
• End to all sanctions
• Release of seized Iranian assets
• End to the naval blockade
• Guarantee of no further attacks
• End to the US ban on Iranian oil sales
• Iran vowed: "We will NEVER BOW"

THE DEAL IS DEAD — FOR NOW
• "Not satisfied" (Friday) → "TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE" (Sunday night)
• Iran "never bow" = maximalist public posture
• The gap between positions is now the widest of the 73-day war
• This is not a negotiating counter — both sides have posted maximalist positions publicly
• The diplomatic track needs a reset — not a tweak

THE WEEKEND ESCALATION — BEYOND HORMUZ
Iran broadened drone attacks to:
• UAE: 2 drones intercepted
• Qatar: cargo ship struck (Qatar hosts Al Udeid = largest US base in Middle East)
• Kuwait: hostile drones in airspace
• If Al Udeid struck: ceasefire immediately over, full war resumes

INDIA'S MONDAY — THREE-WAY PRESSURE
External: Brent $104.49 (+3.16%), US futures -0.3%, Iran attacks broadening
Domestic macro: OMC hike Rs 4-5/L before May 15 — petrol toward Rs 100/L
Domestic signal: Modi conservation speech = demand destruction, WFH, gold moratorium

MARKET PREDICTION 9:15 AM IST
• Sensex: 76,600-76,900 (gap-down 400-700 pts from 77,328 Friday)
• Nifty: 23,600-23,800
• Under pressure: FMCG, Auto, Consumer Durables, Aviation, PSU Banks
• May outperform: OMC stocks (IOC/BPCL/HPCL — hike improves margins), Defence, IT
• Rupee: could weaken to Rs 95.00-95.50 — approaching ATL 95.32
• Partial recovery possible mid-session if Murkowski AUMF seen as forcing deal

THE ONE POSITIVE
Murkowski AUMF introduction today — if the Senate votes, it creates maximum pressure on BOTH sides to reach a deal quickly. This congressional intervention could paradoxically be the catalyst that restarts negotiations. But in the short term: uncertainty + volatility.

VERDICT: Day 73 is the morning after the deal died. Trump said TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE in capitals. Iran said never bow. Brent surged 3.16%. Iran attacked Qatar. And 1.4 billion Indians open the week with a PM who told them to stop buying gold and a government about to raise petrol prices to near Rs 100/L for the first time ever. This is the hardest morning India has faced since the war began.
